scripts.build: BUILD_VERSION="$(git -C .. rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" node scripts/write-build-info.mjs && REACT_APP_CARD_EXT=png react-scripts build
scripts.build:android: BUILD_VERSION="$(git -C .. rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" node scripts/write-build-info.mjs && REACT_APP_USE_LOCAL_AI_ONLY=true REACT_APP_PLATFORM=android REACT_APP_CARD_EXT=png REACT_APP_MULTIPLAYER_ENABLED=false REACT_APP_ADS_ENABLED=false react-scripts build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.release:android: npm run cap:sync:android && echo 'Next: npm run cap:open:android → Build → Generate Signed Bundle (docs/ANDROID_SIGNING.md)'
